subject: Quality Assurance & Testing
title: DevSecOps Principles
description: A micro-lesson that makes DevSecOps Principles usable.

hook.text: A security review happens once before launch. It finds 200 issues. The team has two days to fix them.

buildup.text: Traditional security audits at the end create bottlenecks and impossible timelines for fixes.

discovery.text: DevSecOps integrates security checks into every stage of the development and delivery pipeline.

twist.text: It's not about adding more tools. It's about making security feedback as fast as unit test feedback.

climax.text: Security findings appear in pull requests, not audit reports. Developers fix them the same day.

punchline.text: Security at the end is a wall. Security in the pipeline is a guardrail.

quiz.question: What does DevSecOps integrate into the pipeline?
options: Automated security checks at every stage
